problem_text: A molecular redesign task considers 11 interacting units. Each unit must be assigned exactly one microstate signature from a local catalog. For each interacting unit pair, exactly one interaction record must be selected from a catalog. An interaction record is valid only if its endpoint signatures match the selected signatures of the two units. The total stability score is computed by summing the contributions of the selected local and interaction records, and the goal is to minimize this total score.
